experiment_name: Temporal Robustness and Drift-Aware Adaptation for Ethereum Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection
training_protocol: Static model trained on period_old only. Adaptive detector trained on period_old, evaluated on period_medium before adaptation, retrained on period_old + period_medium upon drift trigger, and evaluated on unseen period_new.
adaptation_protocol: Cumulative retraining on period_old + period_medium when feature-distribution drift exceeds threshold on period_medium. period_new is strictly held out.
dataset_description: SmartBugs-derived POC dataset containing 6 structural Solidity features across 3 temporal cohorts.
temporal_shift_description: Controlled multiplicative feature perturbation simulated with fixed random seed 42.
methodological_note: Temporal cohorts in Phase 2 are controlled experimental cohorts with simulated feature perturbation rather than naturally observed temporal evolution. The drift detector measures feature-distribution shift P(X) and does not establish concept drift P(Y|X). Cohort period_new is strictly held out from training, retraining, scaler fitting, and adaptation decisions. Current results demonstrate the behavior of the experimental protocol, not universal real-world temporal robustness.
